title: Risk measures for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox-BESQ process
abstract: arXiv:2610.36473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a model for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox process with stochastic intensity given by a squared Bessel (BESQ) process. Exploiting the affine structure of the underlying dynamics, we derive a closed-form expression for the joint moment-generating function (MGF) of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval. This MGF can also be obtained at two (or more) dates, thereby allowing an analysis of the time evolution of infinite-server queues driven by a Cox--BESQ process. The availability of these explicit MGFs enables the development of risk measures for these variables, such as the joint moments of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval, conditional on one of these variables exceeding a critical threshold. translated_title: 由Cox-BESQ过程驱动的无限服务台队列的风险度量
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种由Cox过程驱动的无限服务台队列模型，其随机强度由平方贝塞尔（BESQ）过程给出。利用底层动力学的仿射结构，我们推导出了到达强度、系统中顾客数量以及系统内顾客数量在一段时间区间上的积分这三者的联合矩生成函数（MGF）的封闭表达式。该MGF还可以在两个（或多个）时刻获得，从而能够分析由Cox-BESQ过程驱动的无限服务台队列的时间演化。这些显式MGF的可得性使得能够为这些变量开发风险度量，例如在其中一个变量超过临界阈值的条件下，到达强度、系统中顾客数量以及该数量在时间区间上的积分的联合矩。
tldr: 本文利用Cox-BESQ过程的仿射结构，推导出到达强度、系统顾客数及其时间积分的联合矩生成函数封闭表达式，进而构建了以变量超过临界阈值为条件的风险度量。
en_tdlr: This paper derives closed-form joint moment-generating functions for the arrival intensity, the number of customers, and their time integral in infinite-server queues driven by a Cox-BESQ process, exploiting the affine structure to construct risk measures conditional on threshold exceedances.
